record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The five units in appliesTo declare ICE_BALL in this production reference. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (table index), maxPP and stats (including the SPE_DEF the damage scales with). None declares a passive.
record.summary: The caster first gains +10 special defense (for the fight), then deals one hit of special damage to the cast target equal to a star-indexed flat amount plus a star-indexed multiplier times the caster's SPE_DEF read after the +10. No movement and no status.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to process (the unit's current attack target); no retargeting or area
targeting.note: Target selection before the cast and range handling were not read.

geometry.shape: single target; no area, no movement

effects.scaling: raw = base + multiplier x caster SPE_DEF (including the +10 just gained); then AP: damage x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

buffs.scaling: addSpecialDefense called with apBoost 0 and crit false, so the 10 is not scaled by AP or crit; item hooks applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff / applyTwistBandBuff may still modify it (not read)
buffs.duration: not temporary-timed in this call: speDef is raised for the rest of the fight (permanent false means the board Pokemon is not changed)
buffs.stacking: each cast adds another +10 (no cap read here); the boost is applied before the damage, so the first cast already benefits

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column (60, x3) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the five units (1,2,2,1,3). Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy; it only needs a target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No modes. Each cast adds another +10 SPE_DEF to the caster (stacking cap, if any, not read) and deals damage computed from the then-current SPE_DEF, so later casts hit harder.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: flat 10/20/30 plus 0.5/1/1.5 x caster SPE_DEF (1-3 stars). The speDef used already includes this cast's +10. Damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then the target's SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the base process was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
How the caster's speDef is otherwise modified in a fight (items, synergies, statuses) - the field is read as it stands at cast time
unresolved: Whether applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff / applyTwistBandBuff change the +10 (functions not read)
Whether the +10 SPE_DEF has any stacking cap or reset (not read)
Whether any item or synergy effect changes ICE_BALL damage beyond the generic path read
